project.name: sau-kovan
project.productType: Campus walking companion student application with a separate demo console

patterns: one primary action per journey state

must: Support keyboard, mobile and reduced motion
avoid: API endpoints or versions in student UI

decisions: 2026-10-28: User requested a simple student journey. Use a light slate surface, amber actions, a shared-path illustration, and a three-stage journey. Keep the technical console at /demo.

2026-10-28: Keep optional local simulation in a compact modal with journey, operator, notification and setup sections. Use the existing native dialog, buttons and icons. Manual date/time is primary. Real Google routes and WhatsApp delivery must never be represented by synthetic success.

2026-10-28: Extend the student palette and native controls to /operator and /guard. Use a request queue and a focused detail panel, with one primary action per state. Field officers only see their own dispatches and report arrival. Group names are masked on the server; never expose full peer names to the browser.
